name: UIView
description: Adaptive-UI View (plan-38/43, WS1). One deterministically-served UI surface — a nav-sidebar entry, a content page, or a modal/overlay. Design-time authored in Trillo AI (TrilloMD row with modelClassName="UIView"), versioned + GitHub-syncable + promotable; the deploy flattens each authored content blob into this queryable per-app table via DeployAppMetadata.bootstrapUIViews (upsert by uid, reconcile orphans). AOS serves it read-only via the /ui/* serve-API (role-scoped) — no LLM at render time. Flattened columns (uid/role/appRoles/placement/parentUID/order) are queried/served; spec/bindings are JSON payload resolved by the frontend renderer. dataApi: open + admin read-only ACL keeps generic CRUD off (edits happen in Trillo AI, ship via redeploy); the serve-API reads via raised-privilege DataStore. A Flow's views = UIView WHERE parentUID = flow.uid.

attributes.name: uid
attributes.description: Stable identifier for this View — the deploy upsert key and the reference target for UIView.parentUID / UIFlow.entryViewUid. Equals the authoring TrilloMD row's name. Composite unique on (tenantId, uid), enforced at the application layer.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: Primary serving key — the role this View is served to. The role sidebar is fetched by this (one navigation View per role). Holds the coarse exec role (guest/user/admin/system) or an app role name; the serve-API filters on it.

attributes.name: appRoles
attributes.description: Optional JSON array of additional app-role names this View is also served to (secondary gate beyond `role`). V1 filters primarily on `role`; appRoles membership is resolved by the serve-API when set.

attributes.name: placement
attributes.description: Where this View renders. navigation = a role's sidebar entry (the bootstrap surface); content = a routed page; modal/overlay = transient surfaces driven by a Flow.

attributes.name: parentUID
attributes.description: The owning UIFlow.uid when this View is a step of a flow; null for a standalone View. Flat linkage — no nested Views.

attributes.name: sortOrder
attributes.description: Sort order within its placement group (e.g. position in a role's sidebar) or within its parent flow. Named sortOrder (not 'order') to avoid the SQL reserved word.

attributes.name: icon
attributes.description: Optional icon name for a navigation View. Nullable.

attributes.name: spec
attributes.description: JSON payload — the A2UISpec for this View (the component tree the frontend renders deterministically). Not queried; carried opaque to the renderer.

attributes.name: bindings
attributes.description: JSON payload — data bindings the frontend resolves on load by calling the app's existing data/fn APIs (bindings resolution is frontend, not part of the serve-API). Not queried.
